I am a guy. I used to make laundry soap. A grated Fels Naptha bar into a large pot of near boiling water until it dissolves, then I mix in a cup of washing soda. Keep it from boiling and stir or it will foam over the lip of the pot. When it is all dissolved, I pour the mixture into a couple gallons of water, that has a half cup of borax dissolved in it, in a 5 gallon bucket. It makes 3 gallons of highly concentrated laundry soap. It lasts for months. The adding of the washing soda to the heated soap before adding it to the borax mix allows for little hydrophillic tails to be added to any lipids in the soap. It is a fine edge to walk to keep the soap pot from boiling and foaming, but it is a very consistent gel that results, versus the inconsistent and uneven slurry you get from dissolving the washing soda with the borax.

Yes. Be careful working with lye. You cannot really find it at Home Depot any more. It's easier to order online. Remember wear gloves and eye protection. I bought ph test strips online so I can verify that my homemade soap was safe and effective.
